Bug_Details:
Comparison using reference equality instead of value equality Optionals should be compared for value equality using .equals(), and not for
reference equality using == and !=.
Bug_Explanation: The bug was embedded in the generated code by comparing two Optional objects using the '==' operator, which checks for reference equality instead of value equality. This is incorrect and can lead to unexpected results.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUNIT test case triggers the bug by calling the showBug method with Optional objects. The showBug method uses reference equality (==) to compare the Optional objects instead of value equality (.equals()). This results in the test failing as expected.
